Ohio Tax Commissioner 2026 interest-rate journal entry

calculation.reason: Historical rates and all statutory calculation branches have not yet been fully modeled.

annual_rate.notes: The Ohio Tax Commissioner’s official 2026 journal entry certifies 7% under R.C. §5703.47. For the general R.C. §1343.03(B) path, that rate runs from rendition until payment and remains fixed for the judgment. Written instruments, specified tort settlement conduct, another controlling law, Court of Claims matters, workers’ compensation, and periods of dormancy require separate treatment. Ohio Supreme Court authority applies simple interest absent express authority to compound. Verify the applicable branch; not legal advice.
